The concept
of appropriate
technology

Appropriate technology is designed around the people and place it serves: simple to build, affordable to repair, and made from what is already close at hand. It solves a local problem without creating a new dependency.

Technology that fits the place it serves.

Every entry in the archive records who made it, where it is used and how many people it has reached,
so the next builder can start from what already works.

Rice, water, light, tools: the cases collected here come from fields, villages and workshops. Each one is told by the people closest to it.

Built by communities,
shared with everyone.
